study.question: After target-conditioned variants failed to beat the strongest pooled-reference control consistently, can the strongest control retain validation utility at lower measured training and inference cost by omitting its provably zero-influence target-scoring computation?
study.hypothesis: Observed: pooled_reference AUC 0.6307714975 exceeds tied_target 0.6306372598 and radius_target 0.6306798923; tied_target improves over tied_context 0.6304120210 but does not establish incremental utility over the strongest redundant-evidence control. pooled_reference computes a full target readout and radial projection then uses pooled + 0*radial; its candidate-supplied checkpoint diagnostic reports zero summary-vs-pool logit difference. Hypothesis: eliminating that inactive computation preserves its predictive function and reduces measured cost. This is a computational simplification of an existing control, not a new scientific target-readout mechanism or a novel attention method. Nominal pooling controls have differing trained AUCs, so exact training reproduction is uncertain and must not be assumed.

nearest_work.difference: Retain the complete original source, parameter allocation and direct masked mean expression. Override forward to bypass target/context encodings, scorer/softmax/group weighting and radial projection that have zero output influence. Retain zero gradients for every scorer parameter through a small explicit zero-valued parameter dependency; the original remains the checkpoint oracle.

inherited_components: All original embedding and dense parameters, module names, allocation order and RNG draws
The exact pooled_reference masked-mean expression and bias-free appended head
No new optimizer, loss, labels, data passes, sample identity changes or history input
Both source bests remain utility controls: g1-r0019-pooled_observed and g3-r0007-balanced_target; the stronger g3-r0020-pooled_reference remains the primary practical control
study.proposed_difference: Replace execution of the zero-output target-attention/radial branch by the same direct global masked mean and an explicit scalar zero dependency on every attention parameter. Keep original classes intact except renaming final Model to _ExecutedPooledReference and changing literal CONFIG to register execution_mode. The new final Model allocates no parameters. This changes execution rather than predictive capacity; broad novelty is not claimed.
predictions: At the same checkpoint, maximum absolute candidate/original logits error <=1e-5 and pooled-encoding error <=1e-6 on the host first-512 probe; finite outputs for empty and zero-length histories; padding/reordering logit errors <=1e-5. Failures block equivalence claims.
Allocated parameters remain 17270691 including 4226 attention parameters and 17568 appended head parameters; attention receives explicit zero gradients and has no predictive influence.

A complete host training/validation run should cost less than the archived 1038.796 s total / 913.764 s training baseline, with inference faster than 110700.56 examples/s and/or lower batch p50/p95 than 35.369/36.502 ms; all cost measures must be reported, and shared-host timing variability remains a confound.

No predictive gain is expected by mechanism. Predeclared descriptive retention band: absolute AUC difference <=0.0002 and absolute Logloss difference <=0.00005 versus pooled_reference, reported separately. This is an engineering tolerance, not statistical equivalence; larger differences trigger an unresolved training-reproducibility finding rather than a target-relevance explanation.
falsifiers: Checkpoint oracle errors exceed the stated tolerances, outputs become nonfinite, inherited source/allocation changes, or attention acquires predictive influence: implementation-equivalence claim fails.
Measured complete-run training and inference costs do not improve: execution-efficiency hypothesis unsupported even if outputs match.
Validation leaves the descriptive retention bands: do not claim quality retention from one run, and do not attribute the difference to target-conditioned evidence.

Target-conditioned incremental utility remains unsupported unless a target candidate beats pooled_observed and the stronger redundant/capacity controls under repeated matched comparisons; this final efficiency trial cannot establish it.
alternative_explanations: CUDA embedding-gradient reduction ordering, zero-path removal, optimizer execution details and tiny arithmetic changes can alter trained trajectories despite same-checkpoint function agreement.
Single seed, repeated validation selection and winner selection among prior controls can overstate retained quality or an apparent gain.
Shared hardware load, kernel warmup and host feature gathering can explain timing differences; code path removal alone is not a measured end-to-end speedup.

Nominal nulls differ: raw_pooled_duplicate 0.6303451591, centered_null 0.6303864702 and pooled_reference 0.6307714975. Their implementations/graphs differ and this is not an estimate of independent seed variance.

Earlier active branches change representational geometry and optimization together: normalized/raw, radius, empirical, centered and tied trajectories do not isolate a universal causal mechanism. No failed execution is reported in supplied history; negative utility findings are scientific outcomes rather than runtime failures.
The host static snapshots have undocumented as-of dates; this frozen benchmark assumption is not verified production causality.

contrasts.intervention: One fresh standalone pooled_fast candidate under frozen seed 42 and full protocol; only inactive target-scoring execution removed. Same-checkpoint original forward and independent pooling oracle are included in diagnostics.
contrasts.control: Archived exact source/config g3-r0020-pooled_reference, plus the original computation evaluated at the new checkpoint. g1-r0019-pooled_observed and g3-r0007-balanced_target are source utility references; g3-r0019-raw_pooled_duplicate and g3-r0022-centered_null contextualize redundant capacity.
held_fixed: same supplied causal prefixes and 128-event limit
same static/category/brand/action/age inputs and information boundary
same full data, 3 epochs, batch size 4096 and seed 42
same parameter allocation/order, scratch initialization, fusion head and zero initialization
same Adam defaults, learning rate 0.001 and host loss/scorer
remaining_confounds: No fresh concurrently trained control or paired seed repetitions fit the remaining budget.
Checkpoint equivalence cannot establish training-path equivalence or predictive utility.
Allocated capacity remains fixed but inactive execution/zero-gradient graph is intentionally changed.
Single archived timing and validation maxima are not significance estimates.
contrasts.decision_if_supported: Report a preliminary computational simplification with observed quality/cost and checkpoint-equivalence evidence; retain the best validation-supported source/model according to host scores, and leave target complementarity and novelty unsupported.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Retain the incumbent and report the null/negative efficiency or reproducibility finding, with original evidence and any failed receipt preserved. Do not retry automatically.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Register only one variant. Plan <=1100 seconds for its complete training, validation, original-checkpoint diagnostics and costs, leaving approximately 384 seconds before preparation charges. cost_plan.assessment_reserve: The one complete host validation run is the final validation-only assessment for this proposal; its <=1100-second reservation includes scoring and diagnostics. No withheld test, new seed suite or fresh control is requested. Three paired seeds would require several thousand seconds and cannot fit; omitted repetitions are explicit and all conclusions remain preliminary. Freeze file/config/hash and comparison references before the host assessment.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Never exceed the host remaining budget or raise the cap. Stop after this one complete assessment, or on an execution/contract failure. Retain charged failures and unknown states; no automatic duplicate run. If no complete admissible unit fits, run none. No local training, installations, extra agents, holdout access or contract edits.
